name: Kingspan Group plc
summary: Kingspan Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides insulation and building envelope solutions in Western and Southern Europe, Central and Northern Europe, the Americas, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Insulated Building Envelopes, and Advnsys. The Insulated Building Envelopes segment provides advanced energy-saving solutions for roofs, walls, and floors, delivering building solutions for energy efficiency in both new build and renovation applications across all building types.
